messages:
sasha: Heads-up 0 team: ACME and BetaApps both asked to keep legacy model for 9-12 months. We need a repeatable policy + productized offering (not ad-hoc).

liam: Proposal: introduce a "pin service" with 3 SKUs: trial (30d), standard (90d), enterprise (custom, billable). Each SKU defines TTL, support level, and allowed regions.

anya: Important: per-region capacity matters. Suggest per-region soft caps and region-aware eviction order. Example config:
```
pin_service:
  per_customer_limit: 2
  per_region_soft_cap: 50
  default_ttl_days: 90
```

vik: From infra: pinned variants keep KV caches and decoder shards hot. We need quota tracking + a memory surcharge. Recommend surcharge formula: surcharge = max(0, reserved_memory_gb - free_pool) * $X/gb-month.

mira: For launch gates on deprecation, require: product signoff, legal clause published, affected customers notified, canary traffic run (5% for 48h), and regression checks pass on sampled prompts. If any fail, pause.

sasha: On the regression checks: define canary thresholds: semantic score delta <= 1.5%, embedding drift <= 0.02 mean cosine, latency p95 delta <= 12%. Also require downstream contract owners to ack.

liam: Console UX: "Request pin" modal with lane selector, TTL, justification, attach benchmark artifacts. Add auto-generated addendum when SKU = enterprise.

anya: CI job template for pin requests: run 200 synthetic prompts, compute semantic and embed diffs, spin up a lightweight canary at requested QPS for 30m to capture p95. If fail, mark "requires mitigation".

infra-bot: INFO: current pinned_count=28; per_region_soft_cap=50; headroom_ok.

vik: Emergency path: temporary emergency pin for 14d allowed with 3-owner approval (product+infra+legal) and incident tag. Expiry reminders: 45d, 21d, 7d, 1d.

mira: Negotiation playbook for CS: offer migration credits (2 weeks discounted tokens), a migration workshop, and optional one-click graceful redirect for <10% of traffic during migration. If customer wants >180d, require contract amendment and cost pass-through.

sasha: Actions:
- Liam: spec SKU pricing + surcharge calc (3d)
- Anya: CI template + console mock (4d)
- Vik: infra quota + billing hook spec (3d)
- Mira: legal wording + CS negotiation bullets (2d)

sasha: I'll file RW-PL-7602 and assign. Call objections now.

liam: No objections.

anya: No objections.

vik: OK from infra.

mira: OK legal/CS.

infra-bot: Created ticket RW-PL-7602 and assigned to @sasha.
